title: Chart options
description: A chart's options as a JSON object: its defaults (`Meta.options`) or the overrides given in the element's `options` attribute or property, `chart(type, init)`, or the CLI's `--options`. Overrides are layered on the defaults key by key; a typed getter falls back to the default on a missing key or a wrong type (REQ-OPT-010). Changing options keeps the chart's data and view (REQ-OPT-020). This schema holds the options every chart shares; a chart's own options are further keys, which it declares with defaults in its Meta.

mode.description: The variant within the family, one of `Meta.modes`; default the first. A mode not listed is an error naming the valid modes (REQ-CHART-030).

encode.description: Which column plays each channel (x, y, open, …, source, target, ra, dec): a column name, or a list of names for a channel that takes several (y). A chart looks here first, then at a column's `role`, then for a column of the channel's name (REQ-DATA-080).

title.description: The chart's title, drawn in one row at the top when there are at least 10 rows (REQ-LAYOUT-020), truncated with `…`.

locale.description: A BCP 47 tag (`de-DE`). The element's `locale` attribute, the nearest `lang` or `navigator.language` otherwise (REQ-I18N-010); the shell builds the locale pack from it.

localeData.description: A locale pack that overrides the one built from `locale`: the CLI's path, and the way to pin formatting in tests.

timeZone.description: The zone time scales draw ticks and labels in: `UTC` (default), `local`, a fixed offset (`+05:30`) or an IANA name (`America/New_York`). The shell, not the options, carries the resulting offset table (zone.schema.json) into wasm (REQ-TZ-020).

theme.description: Theme tokens that win over the element's custom properties and the defaults (REQ-THEME-010).

position.description: auto: outside in one row when it fits and there are at least 12 rows, else inside the first pane when it takes at most a third of its width and height, else left out of the frame (REQ-LAYOUT-060); outside and inside force one; none draws none. A legend left out stays in the table and the events.

panes.description: Panes stacked top to bottom, sharing the x scale, splitting the rows by weight with at least three rows each (REQ-LAYOUT-050). Default one pane.

id.description: The pane's name, which axes name.

weight.description: The pane's share of the rows; default 1.

scales.description: Scales by name. `x` is the shared x scale; other names are y scales and colour scales, which axes, annotations and the view's `axes` name.

axes.description: Axes, each binding a scale to a side of a pane; a pane holds up to two y axes, gridlines from the first only (REQ-AXIS-010).

annotations.description: Marks in data coordinates, clipped to their pane (REQ-ANNOT-010).

sample.description: How a line-like chart reduces the rows in view: m4 (default, exact per dot column; REQ-SAMPLE-010), lttb (REQ-SAMPLE-060), or none.

spanGaps.description: Join a line across a missing y instead of breaking it (REQ-LINE-030); default false.

retain.description: What a streaming chart keeps (REQ-STREAM-020, REQ-STREAM-030).

rows.description: The ring's capacity, allocated once; default 1,000,000.

age.description: Drop rows older than the newest x minus this: a number in x units, or a duration (`90s`, `15min`, `1h`, `7d`).

drag.description: What a plain mouse drag does: pan (default), brush or zoom (REQ-INPUT-040).

wheel.description: What the plain wheel does: scroll the page (default) or zoom about the pointer (REQ-INPUT-040).

patterns.description: Whether series are told apart by dash patterns, markers and fills as well as colour: auto (default) on in one ink and off in colour; on; off.

scale.description: A scale: a map from a domain value to a continuous cell coordinate and back, or to a palette index for a colour scale.

type.description: linear, log, symlog, time (UTC or `zone`), index (consecutive bars whatever the time between them; REQ-SCALE-060), band and point (categories), angle (wrapping: right ascension, azimuth); and the colour scales sequential, diverging, categorical, threshold.

domain.description: "data": the extent of every series bound to the scale; "view": the x range from the view state, and for a y scale the data visible in it; a fixed list; or {follow: seconds}, the last window of a stream (REQ-SCALE-020). A fixed list is [low, high] for a continuous scale, [low, mid, high] for diverging, the thresholds for threshold, and the categories in order for band, point and categorical.

nice.description: Extend the domain to nice round values, as d3-scale's `nice` (REQ-SCALE-030).

zero.description: Include 0 in the domain; the default for bars.

padding.description: For a continuous scale, a fraction of the span added at each end; for band and point, the fraction of each band left empty.

base.description: For a log scale, the base, above 1; default 10.

constant.description: For a symlog scale, the linear region's half-width; default 1.

zone.description: For a time or index scale, the zone of its ticks and labels, as `timeZone` takes it; overrides `timeZone` and the column's `zone`.

scheme.description: For a colour scale, the named stops to use instead of the theme's (`red-blue`).

axis.description: An axis on one side of a pane.

scale.description: The scale it draws, by name.

pane.description: The pane it belongs to, by id.

orient.description: Which side: left, right, bottom or top.

format.description: A d3-format subset specifier `[sign][$][,][.precision][~][type]` with types f, s, %, e, d (REQ-FMT-020), `auto` (precision from the step), or for a time scale a strftime subset string (REQ-FMT-050).

ticks.description: "auto" (fit as many as the label gap allows; REQ-TICK-030), a tick count, or the tick values.

grid.description: Draw gridlines from this axis's ticks across the pane, on empty cells only.

snap.description: none: ticks at the nearest cell; rows: the domain chosen so every tick lands on a row exactly (default for bar and candlestick y axes under 20 rows; REQ-TICK-050); cells: ticks on whole cells.

title.description: The axis title, drawn when the layout has a row for it.

labelGap.description: The least gap between labels, in cells on x (default 2) and rows on y (default 1).

context.description: For a time axis: draw a context row with the date at each day boundary when the span is under two days (REQ-TICK-070).

oneOf.description: hline: a horizontal line at a y value across its pane, with an optional label in the axis gutter (a candlestick's last price).

scale.description: The y scale the value is in.

label.description: Text drawn on the axis; it hides the tick labels it overlaps.

axis.description: Which gutter the label goes in.

oneOf.description: vline: a vertical line at an x value through every pane.

scale.description: The x scale the value is in; default `x`.

label.description: Text drawn on the x axis.

oneOf.description: band: a range shaded on the back colour, or with `░` in one ink.

scale.description: The scale the range is in: `x` for a vertical band, a y scale for a horizontal one.

label.description: Text drawn at the band's start.

scale.description: The y scale `y` is in; default the pane's first.

oneOf.description: marker: a glyph at a point.

scale.description: The y scale `y` is in; default the pane's first.
